name: Northside Independent School District
districtFact: Northside Independent School District is a San Antonio public school district. Its official website is nisd.net; Northwest Independent School District near Fort Worth uses nisdtx.org.

about.title: About Northside Independent School District
about.content: This page covers Northside Independent School District in San Antonio. Families should use the district calendar for districtwide dates and check their assigned school for campus events, bell schedules, and early-dismissal details.

content: Check the official Northside ISD calendar page for revisions before making travel or child-care plans.
Early-release dates and dismissal times may vary by campus and grade level, so use your school calendar and bell schedule.
Northside ISD publishes resources for military-connected families and an address-based school assignment tool on nisd.net.

districtFaqs.q: Is Northside ISD in San Antonio the same as Northwest ISD?
districtFaqs.a: No. Northside Independent School District is in San Antonio and uses nisd.net. Northwest Independent School District serves the Dallas–Fort Worth area and uses nisdtx.org.

districtFaqs.q: Does Northside ISD have support for military families?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Northside ISD publishes enrollment and transition resources for military-connected families on its official website.

districtFaqs.q: Does Northside ISD have early release days?
districtFaqs.a: Early-release schedules may vary by campus and grade level. Check your school’s calendar and bell schedule for confirmed dates and dismissal times.

districtFaqs.q: How do I find my child's assigned school in Northside ISD?
districtFaqs.a: Use the address-based school assignment tool on Northside ISD’s official website and confirm the result with the district if you have questions.
